script: OpenAI just gave ChatGPT a tiny coworker with its own computer — and it doesn’t clock out. They’re called Dots. Instead of living inside one chat bubble, a Dot can connect to your apps, use its own cloud computer, and keep chewing through a multi-step job in the background. OpenAI is pitching them for real work and personal errands, with specialist Dots for companies, and teams of Dots planned later. But here’s the catch: sensitive actions can still need your approval, and right now Dots require an eligible paid ChatGPT plan, while Meta’s Muse offers a free tier. So the next AI race isn’t just who has the smartest chatbot. It’s who gets to become your always-on digital coworker. Would you give one the keys?
audience: AI-curious adults and knowledge workers deciding whether persistent agents deserve access to their apps
rationale: Derive propositions before staging: introduce/name persistent agency; expand beyond conversation/connect apps; locate work in separate computing; continue successive assigned-job states; propose uses; specialize in preview; qualify future collaboration; interrupt for permission; compare commercial access; reframe competition; invite entrusted access. Retain the eight previously accepted setup concepts and their creative contracts. Replan only s02-connected-work and b02–b04: replace the distributed seam/recess/paper clusters with one supported fold-out cloud-computer task deck. Its governing rule is physical docking followed by development of the same assigned brief on that deck. Hero succession is explicit: the large docking joint, then the cloud-computer input landing, then the identifiable brief changing from gathered sources to an unfinished draft. Each previous feature becomes subordinate before the next takes command. Bot operates accessible edges and controls through authored contact poses, never stands below an unrelated apparatus holding a card. Supplied verified source summaries support factual claims; private visual evidence calibrates hierarchy, material continuity and contact, without supplying facts, shots or runtime assets.
metaphor: A small notched agent token connects the argument across distinct material worlds. In connected work, one cloud-computer deck accepts app material and develops an assigned brief; permission, commercial access and the final trust decision retain separate physical rules.

assets.description: Reuse canonical Motif Bot v1 editable puppet, local fonts, tactile materials, registered adapters, event engine, lexical voice alignment, captions and quality gates. Existing paths require registry resolution; none are inferred.

Production SVG bundle requested in the retained plan: cream circular Dot token with teal notch; separate user-computer silhouette and folded cloud-computer easel; assignment ribbon. The token is a conceptual symbol, never an official avatar or Bot redesign. The obsolete s02 peelable conversation boundary is not used.

Agent-assisted replacement SVG bundle for s02: one cloud-computer silhouette with upright dark display, broad fold-out jade task deck and visible supporting lip; one attached app-source wing with a generic file pocket and two mating coupling faces; a cream brief carrier with a raised corner and teal notch; source, synthesis and unfinished-draft fold faces occupying that same carrier; a small foreground user-chat sleeve. Expose separate transform groups for deck, wing, coupling, carrier, fold faces and sleeve. No detached app clusters, floating source blocks, fabricated screenshots or app logos.
Requested SVG bundle: business brief and household planning envelope; specialist task fittings with permanent PREVIEW band; translucent team diagram under a closed PLANNED LATER cover.
Requested SVG bundle: sensitive-change envelope, arresting paper stop, untouched approval control and scoped-access key with app-tab teeth. The same key returns in the closing invitation.
Requested SVG bundle: equal-size Dots and Muse entry leaves with different admission requirements; no scores, exclusive price, winner badge or unlimited-free claim.
Requested SVG bundle: fold-out editorial comparison object whose conversation face reveals a persistent-work face; isolated user-side key cradle and agent-side receiving recess.

Requested production-scoped action contracts, not existing selectors: retained agency, scope, qualification, permission, access-comparison, editorial-fold and unresolved-key actions; replace the former s02 actions with one finite connected-task-deck action supporting dock, seat, develop and foreground-close phases. New choreography uses ordinary authored planar transforms, bounded paper hinges, masks and pose/contact anchors. Registration and review are required.

Agent-assisted anchor and staging specification requested for the replacement deck: wing push edge, paired coupling faces, carrier push edge, deck entry/landing/stop, fold hinge lines, broad next-step control, Bot palm contact points, sleeve hinge and its maximum occlusion boundary. These are proposed requirements, not selectors. Record contact poses, composed-transform ownership and phase prerequisites.

limitations: Data-only planning attempt 2 of 2. No tools, code, files, web, speech generation, rendering or independent critic execution occurred. Claims rely on the supplied verified packet as of 2026-10-03; references provide visual evidence only.

The eight accepted setup concepts retain their creative contracts. Their earlier static assessments do not establish current structure, direction, moving or final approval. The replacement s02 and the complete revised sequence require fresh independent assessment; no PASS is requested or claimed.

All production SVGs, metadata, action contracts and anchor maps are proposed agent-assisted additions under videos/productions/openai-dots-reference-calibrated/assets/props/. They are not existing files, exposed anchors, selectors or registered capabilities. No canonical promotion is authorized.

Reused puppet, font, material, event-engine, caption and adapter paths were not supplied. Empty reused paths require production-registry resolution before compilation. Canonical Motif Bot v1 geometry remains locked; Bot is Motif's performer, not a Dot or Muse avatar.

Replace the old s02 boundary-peel, connector-engage, cloud-input-seat, job-state-replace and background-layer-continue requirements with one finite agent-assisted connected-task-deck action. Its phases are dock, seat, develop and foreground-close; identity-sleeve exit is part of the entry state. Only reviewed planar travel, bounded hinges, masks and authored canonical contact poses are needed. No physics engine, procedural route solver, SVG morph system or new puppet anatomy is requested.

New s02 anchor requirements are wing push edge, paired coupling faces, carrier push edge, deck entry/landing/stop, fold hinges, broad next-step control, Bot palm contacts, identity recess and sleeve hinge/occlusion limit. Supply separate transform ownership and contact-pose examples for docking, seating and step pressing. These are semantic requirements, never claimed selectors.

The s02 dock phase must block brief travel until coupling faces meet. The seat phase must require completed docking. Work folds must require a seated carrier and visible control contact. Foreground closure must follow established draft identity and must leave the active draft and operative hand visible. Proposed phase prerequisites require adapter implementation and review.

Use interactive-ui-v1 only for its registered bot performance and bot reaction target until the production-scoped deck adapter is registered. Deck, screen, carrier, controls and wing are not enrolled as invented quality reaction targets. Their necessary compression, hinge recovery and corner settling belong to explicitly reviewed action choreography. Focal and framing requests also require registered bindings.

Bot never carries a free prop in replacement s02. It pushes supported edges and presses a supported control. Palm contact must follow the composed prop transform after authored and local motion; resolve any attachment using inverse grip choreography. Unsupported contact or attachment bindings block compilation.

Retained requested action kinds are agency-unfold, assigned-work-persist, scope-replace, specialist-fit-reveal, provisional-cover-reveal, conditional-permission-stop, access-leaf-compare, editorial-fold-reframe and unresolved-key-present. Existing calendar/arena, paper, workshop and interactive UI adapters remain available only within their supplied finite limits; none is forced into an unrelated world.

New art begins as moving rough placeholders. No final artwork before fresh structure review, direction review and both independent moving critics pass with and without captions. Preserve the rejected original and failed concept evidence.

Actual exact-script Kokoro timings at voice_speed 1.03 determine duration and lexical alignment. Preserve short coral serif paper captions with stable letters and speech-driven replacement. No shot, duration, event, reaction or effect quotas. No audio finishing is authorized by this rough-review plan.

Supplied representative, ordered and dense stills support material, state and staging observations. They do not establish easing, velocity, exact contact, continuous performance or audio synchronization. Planned energy is not moving evidence.

Review declared contacts with consecutive native windows of six frames before and after each event, clipped at beat boundaries, plus full-rate traces and playback. Assess all ten quality gates and hierarchy diagnoses explicitly; missing assessment or FAIL blocks advancement. Technical success is separate.

Allow at most two meaningful moving repairs within the supplied brief. Final moving QA, technical checks, later audio finishing and a human watching/listening approval remain required for final production. No publishing or sensitive-action approval is granted.

Cloud computing stays separate from the user device. s02 depicts only an assigned illustrative research/drafting task and stops short of completion; it does not depict proactive sensitive changes. Specialist PREVIEW, team PLANNED LATER, conditional approval, eligible paid access and bounded free-tier qualifications stay visible independently of narration captions. Interfaces are conceptual, without product screenshots or measured results.

narration_span.text: OpenAI just gave ChatGPT a tiny coworker with its own computer — and it doesn’t clock out. They’re called Dots.

narration_span.text: Instead of living inside one chat bubble, a Dot can connect to your apps, use its own cloud computer, and keep chewing through a multi-step job in the background.

rhetorical_chapters.purpose: Describe the pitch while distinguishing use categories, preview specialists and future teams; semantic verbs: propose, replace, specialize, qualify.

narration_span.text: OpenAI is pitching them for real work and personal errands, with specialist Dots for companies, and teams of Dots planned later.

rhetorical_chapters.purpose: Qualify autonomy and compare commercial entry conditions as different limits; semantic verbs: interrupt, await, admit, compare.

narration_span.text: But here’s the catch: sensitive actions can still need your approval, and right now Dots require an eligible paid ChatGPT plan, while Meta’s Muse offers a free tier.

rhetorical_chapters.purpose: Reframe the competition and return authority to the viewer; semantic verbs: reframe, reveal, offer, withhold.

narration_span.text: So the next AI race isn’t just who has the smartest chatbot. It’s who gets to become your always-on digital coworker. Would you give one the keys?
OpenAI just gave ChatGPT a tiny coworker with its own computer — and it doesn’t clock out. They’re called Dots.

setups.semantic_center: Introduce a separately provisioned agent whose assigned work persists.
setups.visual_rule: An assignment unfolds into a distinct cloud workspace; closing the user side does not close assigned work.
setups.hero: Dot token and folded cloud computer
setups.palette_family: Ochre claim stage with cream, teal and dark display
setups.entry_state: Conversation-bound assignment at the user side.
setups.exit_state: Named Dot token beside a separately active cloud workspace.
setups.reason_for_persistence: Provisioning, ongoing activity and naming develop the same introduced-agent relationship.

planned_reset_after.reason: Carry the small token into the mechanism while replacing the introductory workspace.

narration_span.text: Instead of living inside one chat bubble, a Dot can connect to your apps,

setups.semantic_center: A Dot gains an engaged relationship with an app beyond conversation.
setups.visual_rule: The Dot token contacts a fixed app terminal; that contact changes the terminal from disconnected to connected.
setups.hero: Dot token meeting an app terminal across a visible gap
setups.palette_family: Jade access surface with cream and teal
setups.entry_state: The original token rests outside a cropped conversation pocket; the fixed app terminal is separated from it by an open gap.
setups.exit_state: The token contacts the terminal and its two separated connection marks become one continuous mark.
setups.reason_for_persistence: Departure from conversation establishes the starting relationship; terminal contact alone establishes app connection. No input transfer or job processing occurs here.

planned_reset_after.reason: Carry only the unchanged Dot token into separate computing; remove the app terminal and conversation pocket.

narration_span.text: use its own cloud computer, and keep chewing through a multi-step job in the background.

setups.semantic_center: The Dot's separate computer develops the same assigned job through successive unfinished states.
setups.visual_rule: The Dot-controlled computer draws one identifiable job strip through a supported working aperture, exposing successive source, outline and unfinished-draft states.
setups.hero: One job strip developing inside the separate cloud computer
setups.palette_family: Dark teal computing surface with cream job paper and jade backing
setups.entry_state: The original Dot token is attached to the computer's ownership margin. The cream job brief rests at the open input aperture, with its raised corner and teal task notch visible. A separate inactive user-device edge is subordinate.
setups.exit_state: The same brief exposes an unfinished draft and begins revealing its pending continuation; the input edge and user-device context have been cropped away.
setups.reason_for_persistence: Input and development belong to one continuous strip-feeding process. The aperture first receives the brief, then reveals its changing work content; no docking apparatus, additional control mechanism or foreground closure is appended.

planned_reset_after.reason: The argument changes from developing assigned work to describing proposed use categories; leave the entire deck behind.

narration_span.text: OpenAI is pitching them for real work and personal errands,

setups.semantic_center: Propose business and personal task categories.
setups.visual_rule: Task-category material replaces the previous proposal at one shared fitting; no external action executes.
setups.hero: Business brief and household planning envelope
setups.palette_family: Coral wording workshop with warm paper and teal
setups.reason_for_persistence: Both task categories develop the same editorial pitch rule.

planned_reset_after.reason: Task breadth changes to preview task-specific specialization.

setups.semantic_center: Specialize a company task relationship while retaining preview qualification.
setups.visual_rule: Expose compatible task geometry beneath a permanently attached PREVIEW band.
setups.hero: Company task template with specialist fittings
setups.palette_family: Dark teal support with cream and marigold
setups.entry_state: Company template conceals its specialist fittings.
setups.exit_state: Compatible fitting is exposed beside the token, still visibly preview-qualified.
setups.reason_for_persistence: The short proposition has one fit-and-qualification rule; no task execution is appended.

planned_reset_after.reason: Preview specialization and planned teamwork have different availability states.

narration_span.text: and teams of Dots planned later.

setups.visual_rule: A proposal can become visible while its operational joint remains sealed.
setups.exit_state: Visible future diagram with sealed joint and PLANNED LATER qualification.
setups.reason_for_persistence: The reveal explains one availability distinction without demonstrating teamwork.

planned_reset_after.reason: Future capability changes to a present conditional authority boundary.

narration_span.text: But here’s the catch: sensitive actions can still need your approval,

setups.semantic_center: Interrupt a sensitive action and await user authority.
setups.visual_rule: Sensitive material stops before its outgoing boundary; approval cannot be inferred from progress.
setups.hero: Sensitive-change envelope stopped before its outgoing slot
setups.palette_family: Coral limit with cream, teal and dark recess
setups.entry_state: Sensitive envelope approaches its outgoing slot; key remains user-side.
setups.exit_state: Envelope remains pending; approval control and key are untouched.
setups.reason_for_persistence: Approach, arrest and waiting develop one conditional approval rule.

planned_reset_after.reason: User authority and paid-plan eligibility are separate conditions.

narration_span.text: and right now Dots require an eligible paid ChatGPT plan, while Meta’s Muse offers a free tier.

setups.semantic_center: Compare commercial entry conditions without comparing performance.
setups.visual_rule: Equal-scale admission leaves reveal unequal access requirements sequentially.
setups.hero: Paired Dots and Muse admission leaves
setups.palette_family: Warm cream comparison with teal and muted coral
setups.entry_state: Product admission conditions are folded closed.
setups.exit_state: Eligible paid access and bounded free-tier entry are equally legible.
setups.reason_for_persistence: Both sides answer the same access-condition comparison.

planned_reset_after.reason: Commercial evidence gives way to the script's editorial interpretation.

narration_span.text: So the next AI race isn’t just who has the smartest chatbot. It’s who gets to become your always-on digital coworker.

setups.semantic_center: Reframe the competitive question from conversation alone toward persistent assigned work.
setups.visual_rule: A retained conversation face gives way to the deeper work dimension of the same editorial object.
setups.palette_family: Mint explanation with deep teal, cream and marigold
setups.exit_state: Persistent-work face dominates and contains the original token.
setups.reason_for_persistence: Both sentences develop one editorial contrast; the conversation face remains part of the expanded object.

planned_reset_after.reason: The token carries the argument into the closing access decision, leaving the editorial object behind.

narration_span.text: Would you give one the keys?

setups.semantic_center: Offer a scoped-access decision without granting authority.
setups.visual_rule: A user-side key can approach an agent receiving recess but must remain separated until a human decides.
setups.hero: Scoped key separated from the original Dot token
setups.entry_state: Original Dot token faces the scoped key resting in its user-side cradle.
setups.exit_state: Key approaches but remains user-side across an unclosed gap.
setups.reason_for_persistence: The question develops only the possibility of entrusted access, never its execution.

planned_reset_after.reason: End on the unresolved decision with no unlock or approval.
